newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai PM Chavalit confident in economic recovery.
newsitem.headline: Thai PM Chavalit confident in economic recovery.

text.p: Thai Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh said on Monday he was confident the embattled economy would show signs of recovery from July and urged people to be patient.

"After being under attack (when) we fought with everything we've got...our basic economic situation is still very good," Chavalit told foreign journalists, referring to an unsuccessful attack on the baht last week. "Be patient...starting from July, our people will be happy...the tide (will) start to turn again."
